games.name: Clark County
games.desc:
The County of Clark is the largest county in the State of Mayflower, home to the busiest and most populous city in the Union of Columbia; the City of Lander.

The area that is now the County of Clark was settled by colonists hailing from Pax Britannia in December of 1771 as a part of the original 14 colonies as Pax Landeria. Proceeding the end of the revolution against Pax Britannia in July of 1776 and the creation of the Union of Columbia and the State of Mayflower, the County of Clark was created as one of the four original counties of the State of Mayflower.

The current county seat for the County of Clark is the Town of Mersea. Alongside the county seat, the County of Clark is home to the state seat for the State of Mayflower; the City of Lander.

This experience is constantly developing and is prone to changes, including shutdowns and the wipe of player data.

The in-game time period is in the early 2000s.
